transfer_spec.description: Defines the source, sink, and transfer behavior for the Storage Transfer job.
transfer_spec.rationale: The transfer specification controls what data is moved, from where, and under what restrictions.
transfer_spec.compliant: A transfer_spec with an approved source, sink, and restricted transfer conditions.
transfer_spec.non-compliant: A transfer_spec that omits restrictions or uses an unapproved source definition.

gcs_data_source.description: Specifies a Google Cloud Storage bucket as the source for the transfer job.
gcs_data_source.rationale: The source bucket determines what data enters the transfer pipeline. It should reference only approved source locations.

aws_s3_data_source.description: Specifies an Amazon S3 bucket as the source for the transfer job.
aws_s3_data_source.rationale: Using an S3 source introduces external data into the transfer job and should be restricted to approved buckets and credentials.
aws_s3_data_source.compliant: aws_s3_data_source using an approved bucket and credential configuration.
aws_s3_data_source.non-compliant: aws_s3_data_source using an unapproved bucket or unmanaged credentials.

azure_blob_storage_data_source.description: Specifies an Azure Blob Storage container as the source for the transfer job.
azure_blob_storage_data_source.rationale: Azure Blob source definitions should be limited to approved storage accounts and controlled credentials.
azure_blob_storage_data_source.compliant: azure_blob_storage_data_source using an approved storage account and container.
azure_blob_storage_data_source.non-compliant: azure_blob_storage_data_source using an unknown or unapproved storage account.

http_data_source.description: Specifies a list of HTTP or HTTPS URLs as the source for the transfer job.
http_data_source.rationale: HTTP-based sources can introduce integrity and confidentiality risks if insecure or untrusted endpoints are used.
http_data_source.non-compliant: http_data_source referencing HTTP endpoints or untrusted URLs.

posix_data_source.description: Specifies a POSIX filesystem path as the source for the transfer job.
posix_data_source.rationale: POSIX sources can expose local or attached filesystem data and should be limited to approved paths and agents.

hdfs_data_source.description: Specifies an HDFS path as the source for the transfer job.
hdfs_data_source.rationale: HDFS sources should be controlled to prevent broad or unintended data extraction from distributed storage.
hdfs_data_source.compliant: hdfs_data_source using an approved cluster and restricted root path.
hdfs_data_source.non-compliant: hdfs_data_source using an unrestricted or unknown path.

aws_s3_compatible_data_source.description: Specifies an S3-compatible storage system as the source for the transfer job.
aws_s3_compatible_data_source.rationale: S3-compatible endpoints should be approved because they may point to third-party or self-hosted object storage.
aws_s3_compatible_data_source.compliant: aws_s3_compatible_data_source using an approved endpoint and bucket.
aws_s3_compatible_data_source.non-compliant: aws_s3_compatible_data_source using an unknown or untrusted endpoint.

source_agent_pool_name.description: Specifies the agent pool used for agent-based source transfers.
source_agent_pool_name.rationale: Agent pools control where transfer agents run and should reference approved managed pools only.

include_prefixes_required.description: Ensures the Storage Transfer job restricts transfer scope by defining object_conditions.include_prefixes.
include_prefixes_required.rationale: Requiring include_prefixes reduces the risk of unintentionally transferring more objects than intended by limiting the transfer to approved object path prefixes.
